## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
The foundation every module is written against, not a business module: `AuditableEntity` / `GlobalAuditableEntity`
(audit columns, `@Version`, `TENANT_ID` as Hibernate's `@TenantId` — ADR-COMMON-003), `Status` and `ServiceResult<T>`,
`LocalizedException` with registered bilingual error codes (ADR-COMMON-001), the response envelope `ApiResponse` /
`ApiError` and `GlobalExceptionHandler`, the search builders `SpecBuilder` / `PageableBuilder` / `SearchRequest`
(ADR-COMMON-002), `OwnedLookups`, `StatusTransitions` / `DomainRules`, `SecurityContextHelper`, the boolean converters,
`IdempotentResponses` (the `Idempotency-Key` mechanism, table `CORE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY` — internal, not shared) and
`PrintResponses` / `DownloadableContent`. It has no HTTP surface and no shared entity.
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
Always: every entity extends `AuditableEntity`, every error is a `LocalizedException`, every service returns
`ServiceResult<T>`, every controller answers `ApiResponse<T>`, every search uses `SpecBuilder` + `PageableBuilder`,
every expensive POST that clients retry uses `IdempotentResponses`. The `build-*` skills generate against these
types; a module that defines its own base entity, exception, envelope or filter parser is wrong by construction.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// an error with a registered code (EN + AR message in the application's bundles)
throw new LocalizedException(Status.NOT_FOUND, ShopErrorCodes.ORDER_NOT_FOUND, id);

// a search: allowed filter fields, converted values, allowed sort fields, capped page (max 200)
Specification<Order> spec = SpecBuilder.build(request, new SetAllowedFields(FILTER_FIELDS), DefaultFieldValueConverter.INSTANCE);
Page<Order> page = repository.findAll(spec, PageableBuilder.from(request, SORT_FIELDS));
return ServiceResult.success(page.map(mapper::toResponse));

// an idempotent POST (the service method must be @Transactional)
return idempotentResponses.craftResponse(key, "POST /api/v1/shop/orders", request, OrderResponse.class,
    () -> service.create(request));
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->
